evals.name: reserve-name
evals.prompt: Prevent two authors from registering the same author name at append time.
assertions: Targets Unique on the event property rather than the event type.
Supplies a stable rule name and a business refusal message.

evals.name: check-collision
evals.prompt: Exercise two registrations that claim the same name.
evals.expected_output: A stored registration for the first AuthorId and a refusal for the second.
assertions: Uses different source IDs with the same name.
Checks first acceptance and the named violation on the second.
Checks no event was stored for the second AuthorId.

evals.name: release-name
evals.prompt: AuthorRemoved should free the name for another author. Describe the mapping and check.
assertions: Names the original reservation rather than creating a second name.
Checks the subsequent append for the second author is accepted.
